resetPassword.subject: Password reset — M'Arte
resetPassword.preview: A secure password reset for your M'Arte account.
resetPassword.heading: Password reset
resetPassword.message: We received a request to reset the password for your M'Arte account.
resetPassword.messageSecondary: If this was you, set a new password using the button below. Otherwise, you may safely ignore this message — your current password will remain unchanged.
resetPassword.expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, you may simply delete this message.
resetPassword.security: Please never forward this email or share the reset link with anyone.

verifyEmail.subject: Welcome to M'Arte — confirm your email
verifyEmail.preview: One last step before we open the doors to M'Arte.
verifyEmail.heading: Welcome to M'Arte
verifyEmail.message: We are delighted you have joined us. At M'Arte, every detail matters — from the first sketch to the final polish in our workshop.
verifyEmail.messageSecondary: Your account will let you track orders with ease, save delivery addresses, and return to your favourite collections whenever you wish.
verifyEmail.messageTertiary: Before we begin, we ask one small favour: please confirm your email address. This keeps your account secure and ensures we only send you messages that matter to you.
verifyEmail.highlightBody: Once your email is confirmed, your account will be activated. From that moment, you may explore our collections, place orders, and enjoy jewelry crafted with care for every detail.
verifyEmail.expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an M'Arte account, you may disregard this message — no account will be created.

accountDeleted.subject: Your M'Arte account has been deleted
accountDeleted.preview: Confirmation that your account and personal data have been removed.
accountDeleted.heading: Until we meet again
accountDeleted.message: As you requested, we have deleted the M'Arte account associated with this email address. All personal data held in connection with your account has been permanently removed from our systems, in accordance with GDPR.
accountDeleted.messageSecondary: We are sorry to see you go — everyone who chooses M'Arte is special to us. Should you ever wish to return, our doors remain open.
accountDeleted.messageTertiary: Our collection is still here for you. You may continue browsing the shop without an account, or create a new one whenever you are ready.
accountDeleted.security: If you did not request account deletion, please reply to this email as soon as possible — we want to make sure everything is in order.
accountDeleted.signoff: With gratitude for the time you spent with us,

changeEmail.subject: Email address change — M'Arte
changeEmail.preview: The final step to update the email on your M'Arte account.
changeEmail.heading: Email address change
changeEmail.message: We received a request to change the email address linked to your M'Arte account.
changeEmail.messageSecondary: To complete the process and keep your account secure, please confirm your new email address using the button below.
changeEmail.messageTertiary: Until confirmed, we will continue using your current email address.
changeEmail.highlightBody: Email changes require confirmation so that no one else can take control of your account.
changeEmail.expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
changeEmail.ignore: If you did not request this change, please disregard this message — your account will remain secure.
